resources.string: Ikheli lomphakathi (BTC, ETH & EVM, SOL, TRX, XRP, LTC, TON, ADA) noma i-xpub
Kukhona nasemisebenzini yakho: %1$s – kokubili kuyangezwa. Ama-coin afanayo? Khetha “Bonisa kuphela”.
Usuvele ubhala i-%1$s ngemisebenzi yakho. Engeza ibhalansi yaleli kheli ku-portfolio, noma ulibonise kuphela?
“%1$s” manje kuyabonakala kuphela, akubalwa – i-%2$s ivela nasemisebenzini yakho.
Inani elifanayo nediphozithi/ukudlulisa kwakho (%1$s) – kungenzeka kubalwe kabili.
Amakheli abukwayo abalwa kusukela ebhalansini yawo yokuqala ebonakele; izinguquko zakamuva zingukungena/ukuphuma, hhayi inzuzo.
Ikheli lomphakathi kuphela elithunyelwa ku-%1$s – hhayi okhiye noma ama-seed phrase. Umhlinzeki ulibona kanye nekheli lakho le-IP. Kuhlolwa kungadluli kanye emizuzwini engu-10.

I-xpub iveza wonke amakheli ale wallet. Akhiqizwa kudivayisi yakho; amakheli ngamanye kuphela athunyelwa ku-%1$s – okungenani izicelo ezingu-40 ekuskeneni kokuqala, kamuva zibe ncane. Okhiye abayimfihlo (xprv) abamukelwa neze.

Ukusesha kuma ngemuva kwamakheli angu-%1$d alandelanayo angasetshenziswanga (izinga le-BIP44 elisetshenziswa ama-wallet amaningi). Ikheli elisetshenzisiwe elingaphezu kwaleso sikhala alibalwa – lengeze ngokwehlukile.
Mningi kakhulu amakheli asetshenzisiwe ukuthi abuyekezwe
Amakheli amaningi kakhulu – izinkokhelo ezintsha kumakheli amadala angenalutho zingase zingatholakali
Amakheli e-Bitcoin Cash awakwazi ukubukwa: ayikho insiza yomphakathi yamahhala engenayo i-API key imibandela yayo evumela lokhu.
I-BNB Beacon Chain (BEP-2) yavalwa ngo-2024 – amabhalansi manje asku-BNB Smart Chain (0x…)
Amakheli e-Dogecoin awakwazi ukubukwa: ayikho insiza yomphakathi yamahhala engenayo i-API key imibandela yayo evumela lokhu.
Amagama e-ENS awasekelwa – faka ikheli le-0x
Lokhu kubukeka njengokhiye oyimfihlo noma i-seed phrase – ungakufaki neze noma kuphi. Amakheli omphakathi kuphela.
I-akhawunti ye-Taproot (BIP86): amakheli e-bc1p… akhiqizwa kulo khiye, okwamukela nokwenshintsho.
I-wallet ye-Taproot? Esikhundleni salokho namathisela i-descriptor tr(…) evela ku-wallet yakho – i-xpub evamile isesha kuphela njengamakheli e-Legacy ne-SegWit.
Noma ngubani oqhuba i-%1$s ubona wonke amakheli abuziwe ale wallet futhi angawaxhumanisa komunye nomunye nasekhelini lakho le-IP.
Ukugwema lokhu, faka iseva yakho ku-Izilungiselelo › I-portfolio › Iseva yakho yamakheli.
